# Dubai Creek Harbour Substation

> This 132/11 kV primary substation serves Dubai Creek Harbour, a waterfront district on the Ras Al Khor creek frontage made up of residential towers, a marina, retail promenades, hotels and parkland facing the Ras Al Khor Wildlife Sanctuary. It steps 132 kV transmission supply down to 11 kV for distribution across the district, forming part of the emirate's high-voltage network.

## Project Overview

- Category: Infrastructure & Utilities
- Location: Dubai Creek Harbour, UAE
- Status: Completed

## MENASCO Scope

The Dubai Creek Harbour 132/11 kV Substation is a DEWA transmission substation serving the Dubai Creek Harbour development. It steps 132 kV transmission power down to 11 kV for local distribution. MENASCO carried out the MEP works for the substation building, working for Intermass Engineering & Contracting with Green Energy Consultancy as consultant.
